name: 💀 Hide or Die!
desc:
Hide or OOF is a combination of hide and seek and prop hunt! The game was previously called Hide or Die.

🫣 AS HIDER: Morph into props and hide around the map, get weapons and use powers to distract the seekers. DON’T GET CAUGHT!
👀 AS SEEKER: Try to find the hiders and kill them. Once you kill them they’ll join your team. FIND ALL HIDERS!

🪙 Collect coins to get better powers and weapons!
⭐ Premium Players get a FREE Diamond Blaster skin and faster AFK Presents!

Made with 💙 by 1CoaI, alextubbaa, xJa_ys, Drawees, skyfloans
